name.value: The Guitar Shop Off Elm Street

about.value: The Guitar Shop Off Elm Street is an independent guitar shop located in South End Greensboro, NC. We specialize in buying and selling vintage and pre-loved guitars, offer full services and repairs, and provide space for local music teachers.
